description: This file defines the WorkflowTransitionAddForm class, a Drupal form for adding workflow transitions, including form building, validation, and saving logic.

classes.name: WorkflowTransitionAddForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for adding workflow transitions, handling form creation, validation, and submission.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting the plugin form factory dependency.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with container dependencies.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the transition addition form with fields for label, id, from, to, and additional settings.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a transition with the given ID already exists in the workflow.

methods.name: copyFormValuesToEntity
methods.description: Copies form values to the entity, adding a transition.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates that the transition does not already exist and validates additional plugin form configuration.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the workflow transition and redirects to the workflow edit form.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Defines form actions, such as the submit button.
